dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT tff.feedback_form_id, tff.feedback_form_title, tff.feedback_form_header, tff.feedback_form_status, tff.last_modified, tu.user_id, CONCAT(USER_FNAME,' ', USER_LNAME) AS createdBy FROM tp_feedback_forms tff, tp_users tu WHERE tff.user_id=tu.user_id AND tff.feedback_form_status=? ORDER BY feedback_form_title

SELECT tfff.feedback_form_field_id, tfff.feedback_form_id, tfff.feedback_field_id, tfff.feedback_form_field_desc, tfff.feedback_form_field_rank, tfff.feedback_form_field_type, tfff.rating_id, tfff.select_id, tfff.feedback_form_field_comment_required, tfff.feedback_form_field_display_type, tfff.feedback_form_field_is_mandatory, all_fields.feedback_field_title, all_fields.feedback_field_type, all_fields.applicant_field_id, all_fields.system_generated FROM tp_feedback_form_fields tfff, ( SELECT category_id as feedback_field_id, CASE WHEN summary_field = ? THEN CONCAT(category_name,?) ELSE category_name END as feedback_field_title, ? as feedback_form_field_type, ? AS feedback_field_type, NULL AS applicant_field_id, system_generated FROM tp_feedback_field_categories UNION SELECT feedback_field_id, feedback_field_title, ? as feedback_form_field_type, feedback_field_type, applicant_field_id, system_generated FROM tp_feedback_fields ) AS all_fields
WHERE tfff.feedback_field_id = all_fields.feedback_field_id AND tfff.feedback_form_field_type=all_fields.feedback_form_field_type AND tfff.feedback_form_id=? ORDER BY tfff.feedback_form_field_rank
SELECT feedback_form_id, feedback_form_title, feedback_form_header, user_id, feedback_form_status, feedback_form_display_type FROM tp_feedback_forms WHERE feedback_form_id=?
SELECT count(*) FROM tp_position_steps tps ,tp_positions tp WHERE tp.position_id=tps.position_id AND tp.position_status=? AND position_step_status=? AND tps.feedback_form_id=?
UPDATE tp_feedback_forms SET feedback_form_status=? WHERE feedback_form_id=?
SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicant_selection_process_traits WHERE feedback_form_field_id IN (@@)
SELECT count(*) FROM tp_applicant_selection_process_traits WHERE feedback_form_id IN (@@)

INSERT INTO tp_feedback_form_fields(feedback_form_id, feedback_field_id, feedback_form_field_desc, feedback_form_field_rank, feedback_form_field_type, rating_id,select_id, feedback_form_field_comment_required,feedback_form_field_display_type,feedback_form_field_is_mandatory) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
UPDATE tp_feedback_forms SET feedback_form_title=?, feedback_form_header=?, last_modified=now() WHERE feedback_form_id=?

UPDATE tp_feedback_form_fields SET feedback_form_field_desc=?, feedback_form_field_rank=?, rating_id=?, select_id=?, feedback_form_field_comment_required=?, feedback_form_field_display_type = ?, feedback_form_field_is_mandatory = ? WHERE feedback_form_field_id=?

SELECT category_id as feedback_field_id, category_name as feedback_field_title, ? as feedback_form_field_type, '' as feedback_form_field_desc, system_generated, 0 as feedback_form_field_comment_required, 1 as feedback_form_field_display_type, 0 as feedback_form_field_is_mandatory FROM tp_feedback_field_categories WHERE system_generated=? UNION SELECT feedback_field_id, feedback_field_title, ? as feedback_form_field_type, feedback_field_desc as feedback_form_field_desc, system_generated, 1 as feedback_form_field_comment_required, ? as feedback_form_field_display_type, 0 as feedback_form_field_is_mandatory FROM tp_feedback_fields WHERE system_generated=?
